chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, forbade the payment of the reciter who does not recite except for a stipulated wage.

key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.نَهَى: forbade; indicated a prohibition or forbiddance

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbid taking a stipulated fee for Qur'an recitation?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade payment for recitation when the reciter only recites on the basis of a stipulated fee. It addresses the conduct of recitation as a livelihood matter and indicates disapproval of making recitation dependent upon preconditioned compensation.
